pictures.name: path_worn_smooth
pictures.scene: a narrow footpath worn smooth through summer grass and climbing gently out of the bottom of the frame, its stones lit warm and low, the hillside above it going soft and blue toward an open sky

pictures.name: first_figs
pictures.scene: a low fig branch bent heavy with ripe purple fruit, the nearest figs lit warm and full at the bottom of the frame, the broad leaves above them dark and quiet against a deep late afternoon sky

pictures.name: vine_on_the_wall
pictures.scene: an old grapevine trained across a sunlit courtyard wall, its heavy clusters hanging low and lit warm along the bottom of the frame, the wall and leaves above them settling into cool green shade

pictures.name: olive_shoots
pictures.scene: a ring of young olive shoots springing up close around the base of one thick old olive trunk, the new growth lit bright and low, the great gnarled tree above them dark and broad against a pale sky

pictures.name: terraced_hillside
pictures.scene: a wide terraced hillside of vines and olive trees rising toward a walled city on its crest, the lowest terraces lit warm and green, the higher slopes and the walls above them soft and dim and blue

pictures.name: old_tree_and_saplings
pictures.scene: one ancient olive tree with its own young saplings rooted about it in a quiet grove, the low grass and the nearest trunks lit warm gold, the canopy overhead dark and still against evening

lines.text: Blessed are all who fear the LORD,
For when you eat the fruit of your labor,
blessings and prosperity will be yours.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine
In this way indeed shall blessing come
to the man who fears the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion,
that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem
all the days of your life,
